title: Moroccan Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic Moroccan-inspired dish featuring lamb kebabs with a blend of spices, perfect for a summer evening. This recipe is ideal for lamb lovers and those who enjoy the bold flavors of North African cuisine.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Use boneless lamb shoulder for best results.

ingredients.name: Moroccan spice blend
ingredients.notes: You can make your own spice blend or use store-bought.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality olive oil for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Yellowed onions, sliced
ingredients.notes: You can use any color onion, but yellowed onions add a sweet flavor.

ingredients.name: Crisp bell peppers, sliced
ingredients.notes: Any color bell pepper works well, but crisp ones add a nice crunch.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt or sea salt for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley, chopped
ingredients.notes: Use fresh parsley for the best flavor and texture.

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together the Moroccan spice blend, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
2. Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Thread the lamb cubes, onions, and bell peppers onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
7. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
8. Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and garnish with chopped parsley.
10. Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
